framings.title: Render a Vega-Lite chart to SVG
framings.description: Render a Vega-Lite v5 chart specification, with its data supplied inline or as files, to a byte-reproducible accessible SVG: the same request always yields the same bytes and ni: content address; text stays text; hatched fills and title/description are built in. Offline and deterministic, so a figure can live as data and be rebuilt anywhere.

spec.description: Two bars: a is 3, b is 5.

data.description: Either an array of rows (inline data for a spec with no top-level data) or a map of root-relative path to file text (or JSON value) that the spec's data.url values resolve to.

baseUrl.description: Root-relative directory the spec's relative urls are resolved against (the directory the spec file lives in). Default: the root.
